claims.claim: We offer all our clients 5 star☆ service
claims.evidence: Witness report shows engine-bay photos only; no service/ratings evidence.

claims.claim: Never buy an item because it's cheap, cause you might not...
claims.evidence: Witness report contains no information about the item’s quality or any warning details.

risks.risk: Exact motorcycle make/model and year are not readable, so compatibility is uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the bike’s make/model/year label (or VIN/engine number plate) and a matching part number/label on the engine/ECU/airbox.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly incompatible engine-bay part set (worst-case fitment risk).

risks.risk: Engine completeness is unknown (missing parts like carb/injector, ECU, sensors, ignition components, covers).
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the entire engine/major components laid out, including ECU/sensors/ignition and all mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown working status (worst-case missing components).

risks.risk: Working status is unknown (may not start/run; compression/overheating history not shown).
risks.proof: A short video of the engine starting and idling (or a compression test reading and overheating/repair history).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst-case non-working).

risks.risk: Internal condition (cracks, oil leaks, corrosion, wear) is not visible because key areas are under covers.
risks.proof: Photos through openings/removed covers, plus close-ups of gasket surfaces, crankcase seams, and any leak points.

risks.risk: Wiring/connector/ECU condition is unknown; colored wiring and a connector are visible but functionality is not.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the connector pins and any ECU/relay labels, plus a continuity/scan test if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical condition unverified (worst-case faulty wiring/ECU).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the motorcycle make/model/year (or VIN/engine number plate) and the engine/part number label.
Send photos showing the full engine/assembly (including ECU, sensors, ignition components, carb/injector details) and all mounting points.
Provide a video of the engine starting and idling (or compression test results).
Send close-ups of any wiring/connector pins and the ECU/relay area (if present), showing labels/condition.
Show underside/inside areas: gasket surfaces, crankcase seams, and any signs of oil leaks/corrosion (with covers removed if needed).
response.reason: The witness can only confirm an engine-bay/engine-cover area with no readable model/compatibility and no working-status evidence. Without key shots (identity and completeness/working proof), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
